title: THC Simple User Guide — Batch 1
purpose: Simple beginner infographic guide for lawful home cannabis cultivation.
readerPath: What stage they are in → what the plant needs → what to do → what to avoid → what comes next
scope: Starter path from setup to cure.
termsPolicy: Terms come after the first 10 pages and should be derived from words actually used in the set.

designRules.readingLevel: Beginner. Plain language. No advanced science.

pages.title: Setup
pages.goal: Show that the grow space must be ready before starting seeds.
pages.information:
- Set up first
- Have the basics ready
- Keep it clean and safe
- Plan drying and curing before harvest
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Setup**

**Get ready before you start seeds.**

**Have ready:**
- Light or sun
- Pot with drainage
- Simple grow mix
- Water
- Airflow
- Drying and curing space

**Avoid:**
Starting seeds with no plan.

**Simple rule:**  
Set up first. Start seeds second.

pages.title: Seeds
pages.information:
- Seeds need moisture, warmth, and patience
- Do not drown or overhandle the seed
- Move on when the root appears
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Seeds**

**A seed wakes up with moisture and warmth.**

**Needs:**
- Moisture
- Warmth
- Gentle handling
- Time

**Avoid:**
Drowning it or checking too much.

**Move on when:**  
The first white root appears.

**Simple rule:**  
Moist. Warm. Gentle. Patient.

pages.title: Seedling
pages.information:
- Seedlings are fragile
- Use gentle light and light watering
- Avoid overwatering and heavy feeding
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Seedling**

**A seedling is a baby plant.**

**Needs:**
- Gentle light
- Light watering
- Clean air
- Time to grow roots

**Avoid:**
Too much water, food, or strong light.

**Move on when:**  
It has several healthy leaves.

**Simple rule:**  
Baby plants need gentle care.

pages.title: Veg
pages.goal: Teach that veg is the plant-building stage.
pages.information:
- Veg builds roots, stems, leaves, and branches
- Water carefully
- Keep airflow moving
- Do not overfeed or overwater
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Veg**

**Veg is when the plant grows bigger.**

**The plant builds:**
- Roots
- Stems
- Leaves
- Branches

**Do:**
Water when the pot starts to dry.

**Avoid:**
Overwatering and overfeeding.

**Simple rule:**  
Veg builds the plant’s body.

pages.title: Flower
pages.goal: Teach that flower is bud-forming stage and patience matters.
pages.information:
- Buds form
- Airflow matters
- Do not interrupt dark period for photoperiod plants
- Watch moisture and mold risk
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Flower**

**Flower is when buds begin to form.**

**Needs:**
- Steady light schedule
- Good airflow
- Careful watering
- Patience

**Avoid:**
Wet, stale air around buds.

**Watch for:**
Buds getting bigger and smell getting stronger.

**Simple rule:**  
Patience protects quality.

pages.title: Harvest
pages.goal: Teach not to harvest too early.
pages.information:
- Buds should look mature
- Use clean tools
- Prepare drying space first
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Harvest**

**Harvest means cutting the plant when buds are ready.**

**Look for:**
- Full buds
- Strong smell
- Darker curled hairs
- Mature trichomes

**Do:**
Use clean tools.

**Avoid:**
Cutting early because you are excited.

**Simple rule:**  
Harvest when the plant is ready.

pages.title: Dry
pages.goal: Teach drying as a critical step, not an afterthought.
pages.information:
- Dry slowly
- No heat rushing
- Gentle airflow, not direct fan blast
- Watch for mold
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Dry**

**Drying slowly removes moisture after harvest.**

**Needs:**
- Darkness
- Gentle airflow
- Moderate temperature
- Time

**Avoid:**
Heat, bright light, and direct fan blast.

**Move on when:**  
Buds feel dry outside and small stems bend or snap.

**Simple rule:**  
Fast drying can ruin good flower.

pages.title: Cure
pages.goal: Teach cure as the final finishing and storage step.
pages.information:
- Cure happens after drying
- Use clean containers
- Do not jar wet buds
- Store cool and dark
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Cure**

**Curing is the final step after drying.**

**Needs:**
- Clean jars or containers
- Cool storage
- Darkness
- Mold checks

**Do:**
Open containers early if moisture builds up.

**Avoid:**
Jarring wet buds.

**Simple rule:**  
Dry first. Cure second.

pages.title: Pests
pages.goal: Teach early pest spotting without turning it into pest science.
pages.information:
- Check under leaves
- Look for bugs, spots, webs, eggs, damage
- Keep the space clean
- Do not spray random products on buds
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Pests**

**Pests are problems that can damage plants.**

**Check for:**
- Tiny bugs
- Eggs
- Webbing
- Leaf spots
- Chewed leaves

**Do:**
Look under leaves often.

**Avoid:**
Spraying random products on buds.

**Simple rule:**  
Catch pests early.

pages.title: Tips
pages.goal: Give the new grower survival rules.
pages.information:
- Start small
- Do not overwater or overfeed
- Keep air moving
- Keep clean
- Change one thing at a time
- Be patient
pages.onPageMarkdown:
**THC Simple User Guide**  
**Tips**

**Beginner rules that matter most:**

- Start small
- Check before watering
- Feed lightly
- Keep air moving
- Keep it clean
- Change one thing at a time
- Take pictures
- Be patient

**Simple rule:**  
Healthy basics beat complicated tricks.
